title: Decompose complex variants and establish publish checklist for data components
creator: Aditi Rao
description:
Context: The data-visualization primitives (button groups, chart cards, table rows) in the Figma library have accumulated multi-purpose compound variants and inconsistent auto-layout constraints. This causes high cognitive overhead for product teams, frequent visual regressions after publishes, and long engineering handoffs.

Goal: Break down compound variants into atomic variant axes, normalize auto-layout vertical/horizontal constraints, and introduce a publish checklist + gating flow so that library publishes are safe and reversible.

Scope: buttons (all size/density variants), table row states, chart legends and tooltips, tokens referenced by those components. Deliverables: RFC in Confluence, decomposed Figma components with clear naming, automated publish checklist, a migration note for product teams, and one canary publish for runtime-1.18 teams.

Out of scope: full token rename across entire library (to be handled by separate PR).
acceptance_criteria: All compound variants for target components split into single-axis variant sets in the Figma library
Auto-layout constraints for buttons/tables/charts normalized and documented in component notes
Publish checklist implemented and linked in the library file; publish requires checklist sign-off
One canary publish completed and monitored for 48 hours with rollback plan
Migration guide published and linked in the PR
